# Other Sources

## Source priority (overall)

1. `rodrigomatos.tech` — current public professional profile and quantified achievements (`sources/personal-site.md`).
2. Rodrigo's LinkedIn profile/export (`sources/linkedin.md`).
3. Public GitHub profile and repositories (`sources/github.md`).
4. Rodrigo's own project sites, especially GeoAlert (`projects/personal/geoalert.md`).
5. User-provided career context and verified conversation history.
6. Generated interpretation — must always be marked as interpretation, not fact.

## GeoAlert

Official project site: https://www.geoalert.com.br/ — see `projects/personal/geoalert.md`.

## User-provided conversation context

Useful for projects/workflows (e.g. BTC/Crypto exploration, Career Form Assistant design), but not automatically treated as public CV fact.

## Reconciliation rule

Do not silently reconcile source differences between any of the sources above. Preserve the distinction until Rodrigo confirms the preferred wording. For application generation, prefer the newest first-party source and avoid unsupported claims.
